intervention: re-resolved every archived assertion emission with today's code (90 artifacts, 204 case-runs, tuned cases, head-only sweeps skipped) and asked, through the STRIDE rules' own helpers _principals_of and _presented_on, whether each settled row about a principal or a credential reaches an element.
